p.i: sint, & eâ ratione Magistra-tuum animos exacerbaturi & ab Ecclesiâ cum præsentissimo il-lius malo abalienaturi. Hoc con-silium meum, ut pius placeat & pacis studiosis pectoribus opto; non quòd doctrina quam propo-no, in ambiguo posita sit, & nondum decisa (contrarium e-nim patet ex hac Disputatione in quâ ut dixi non meam priva-tam, sed totius Ecclesiæ Refor-matæ doctrinam propono) verũ[?] ut omnia ordine perfecto digerā-tur; si qui in hac materia non a-deo versati sunt, plenè instruātur, si quæ durius aut generaliùs vel

page.notes: The faint mark at the bottom left, before the catchword, is hard to read and is left as [?]; it may be a page number or a signature. The catchword "ab" is taken from the bottom right. The page opens mid-sentence, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". Some letters, such as the tilde over "verũ", "digerā" and "instruātur", are faint in the scan.
